svg.title: Metadata-driven ingestion architecture in Microsoft Fabric
svg.desc: Fabric SQL Database stores source configuration, watermarks, and run audit. Fabric Data Pipelines select and paginate ingestion requests, dispatch objects through a ForEach activity, and use a Lookup in the Object Controller to route to database or file adapters. SQL Server tables are loaded directly to Bronze through a SQL query Copy activity. SFTP CSV files use Binary Copy to Lakehouse Landing followed by a Notebook that parses CSV and appends to the same Lakehouse Bronze Delta tables. Recovery and monitoring are described separately.
svg.text: Simplified flow · checkpoint updates and recovery paths omitted
